The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b9fec0a6b56d3a8d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 6. statement: Let (P, ω) be a closed symplectic manifold and let g be a Hamiltonian diffeomor- phism with g2 = id. Its fixed locus is a finite disjoint union of closed symplectic submanifolds, Fix(g) = F1 ⊔ · · · ⊔ Fr. For each j, prescribe a smooth Morse function hj : Fj → R. There is a smooth g-invariant function f : P → R restricting to hj on Fj such that, for every sufficiently small ϵ > 0, Fix(ψϵ ◦ g) = r G j=1 Crit(hj), where ψs is the Hamiltonian flow of f. Every fixed point in this list is nondegenerate. The map ψϵ ◦ g is the time-one map of a smooth one-periodic Hamiltonian. If P is simply connected, all fixed-point loops for that Hamiltonian are contractible.
